description: Ministry of Higher Education & Highways - Amendment of Degree Awarding Status of the South Asian Institute of Technology and Medicine (SAITM) (PVT) Ltd.,  that Published in the Gaz. Ex. No. 1829/36 of 26.09.2013
categorisation: This gazette content involves the amendment of a legal order under the Universities Act, No. 16 of 1978. It specifically modifies a previous statutory instrument (an Order) related to degree-awarding status for an institution. The content is focused on regulatory and legal matters concerning higher education legislation, falling squarely under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for statutory instruments and regulatory modifications.
